Attend the play that Bokka will be watching.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Meet [[Kehanni]] in the [[the Mirror of Lyss]].
* Schmooze with [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent|Bokka the Magnificent]] at his palace in [[Resplendent Makuun]].
* Hobnob with [[Vaughn the Venerable]] at the [[Bokka Amphitheatre]].
* It's a trap! Defeat the [[Kournan]] elite forces.
* See [[Royal Finance Minister Oluda]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Lightbringer Points]]

==Walkthrough==
After accepting the quest from [[Royal Food Taster Rendu|Rendu]], head North out of the [[Kodash Bazaar]] through [[The Mirror of Lyss]] and follow the map to [[Kehanni]], who is just outside of the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]]. Before continuing, enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh to save traveling time later.

Exit back into The Mirror of Lyss and head southeast to enter the [[Honur Hill]] outpost.

Follow the map through [[Resplendent Makuun]] to talk to [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]], and then follow the quest marker which leads to [[Bokka Amphitheatre]]. Head through the portal and watch the play until Ernald the Exact says "This is my favorite part." - at which point the actors reveal themselves to be a Kournan ambush.

Once you have defeated the Kournans, travel back to Honur Hill and talk to [[Royal Finance Minister Oluda]] for your reward and the next quest (if you want to see a [[All's Well That Ends Well (cinematic)|cinematic]], approach the exit to Resplendent Makuun before map travel).

;Royal Finance Minister Oluda
:''"How embarrassing! The esteemed Prince Bokka sends his apologies. He has since made haste to safer grounds but left this with me to give to you."''

==Notes==
* It is advisable, after talking to Kehanni, to proceed past her (to the northeast) and enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. This outpost will make later exploration, quests and missions easier to complete if you can map travel to this location. Outposts exist at each corner of The Mirror of Lyss and all are important to the storyline.
* Tyrian players will recognize the play as a loosely told [[Storyline of Prophecies|story of the events of Prophecies]] leading up to the refugees' arrival in Kryta

== Trivia ==
* The quest name could be derived from the Shakespeare play [[w:All's Well That Ends Well|All's Well That Ends Well]].
* The cinematic dialogue is a parody of the play [[w:Waiting For Godot|Waiting For Godot]].
